title: RWB-S7-E6020-APP: the review date has no property, field ID, column or list, the legacy timer table is not S7's, R-WO-17's owner conflicts with the FSD role and the permission table, the plan's C row is empty while the step consumes four contracts, DP-04, DP-09 and DP-10 are absent, and no source publishes a rule, a message or a state for a date in the past or a second decision at DEFERRED
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6020-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-020; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.3, A2.8, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-17, R-WO-18 and R-WO-19; Batch and Scheduling Design v4, JOB-05 and JOB-16; API Specification v4, CommitteeDecision and DecisionLogEntry; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-08
description: (1) review_date is the only condition of R-WO-17 and the refusal condition of R-WO-18, yet it has no property in the published CommitteeDecision element (API Specification v4 gives decision, resolutionReference and membersPresent only), no column in write_off (TSD S7 T3.1 lists DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020), no entry in the FSD S7 A2.8.3.2 field catalog (eight write_off fields), no field ID and no list; TSD S7 T3.2 publishes no list at all. (2) The legacy Data table lists timer with DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 and task_id, expires_at and 4 more, but S7 owns one table only in the context pack, so no timer table is S7's and the review timer has no row of its own here. (3) R-WO-17's owner is 'Write-off team' and its systems are 'Workbench scheduler, Committee View', while FSD S7 A2.8.3.3 gives 'Write-off committee member' as the primary role and the legacy permission table gives right A to RW-CREDITAD, RW-PRODHEAD, RW-WOCOMM and RW-FINANCE, so the business role of the rule row and the roles of the permission table do not use the same name. (4) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6020-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case, answers two rwb-case case moves, answers the rwb-case timer and reads the rwb-decision package, so four consumed rows have no plan row. (5) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates R-WO-17 to R-WO-19 of the WO route set of 51 rules over 27 states, so no kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (6) DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 with event EV-24, so RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row although the step publishes nothing. (7) DP-10 is absent although R-WO-17 sets a review timer and R-WO-19 fires it, so RWB-PLT-E1071-CON is absent and no Schedule or job kit is held. (8) No source publishes a validation rule, a message or a state for a review date in the past or earlier than the next cut-off, and TSD S7 T4 publishes 25 rows closing at R-WO-25 with 'and 26 more', so no published row decides a case that is already DEFERRED. (9) TSD S7 T8 maps every REQ-S7 row to FEAT-WOF-01 while the FSD Requirements served table gives REQ-S7-003 as the committee decision of approve, reject or defer.
evidence: API Specification v4 CommitteeDecision properties decision (enum approve, reject, defer), resolutionReference and membersPresent, and DecisionLogEntry with its required list id, decisionCode, inputsRef, finalCall, decidedAt, prevHash, entryHash and chainSeq; TSD S7 T3.1 field list DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with no review-date column and T3.2 as an empty list table; FSD S7 A2.8.3.1 rows VR-S7-008-1, R-WO-17 and BR-S7-008, A2.8.3.2 field catalog of the eight write_off fields, A2.8.3.3 role 'Write-off committee member' primary; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-17 (owner Write-off team, systems Workbench scheduler and Committee View, timer to the review date), R-WO-18 and R-WO-19 (timer next cut-off); TSD S7 T6.1 rights RA for RW-WOCOMM and RW-PRODHEAD, CRUA for RW-CREDITAD, RA for RW-FINANCE; legacy RWB-E6-020 Data table listing recovery_case, timer (DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036), decision_log_entry and rule_row, and Permission checks right A for RW-CREDITAD, RW-PRODHEAD, RW-WOCOMM and RW-FINANCE; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6020-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; TSD S7 T4 rows R-WO-01 to R-WO-25 and 'and 26 more'; TSD S7 T8 mapping REQ-S7-001 to REQ-S7-008 to FEAT-WOF-01; Batch and Scheduling Design v4 JOB-05 (TimerScheduler for every caller) and JOB-16 (write-off scan)
area: Field definition, timer ownership, role mapping, dependency rows, state machine and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; carry the review date as an additive request property recorded in the decision record and the case move, with no column and no field ID until the business lead and rwb-case confirm them; set the review timer as a durable workflow timer and let rwb-case own the timer row; map R-WO-17's owner to the roles that hold right A for the act and to the write-off team for the return; declare the four consumed rows in sections 12.2 and 12.8 and record the absent DP-04, DP-09 and DP-10 rows; leave a second decision at DEFERRED and a past review date unpublished and tracked

title: RWB-S7-E6020-CON: the CommitteeDecision and DecisionLogEntry properties, the review-date addition, the review-timer element name, the four consumed operation names and the message per error condition have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6020-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-020; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.8.2, A2.8.3.1, A2.8.3.2, A2.8.4.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T8 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-17, R-WO-18 and R-WO-19; API Specification v4, CommitteeDecision and DecisionLogEntry
description: (1) TSD S7 T-A.2 publishes the request element name CommitteeDecision, the response element name DecisionLogEntry and the error status codes 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503, but no property of either element, no required flag, no type and no message ID per condition; the properties are only in API Specification v4, and the two documents do not state which is the baseline. (2) The published CommitteeDecision carries decision, resolutionReference and membersPresent and no review-date property, while R-WO-17 requires review_date present and R-WO-18 refuses a defer without it, so the baseline has to add a property the specification does not publish, and no source gives its field ID, length, list or optionality. (3) The review timer has no element name in any source: no operation, activity or signal is published for setting or cancelling a timer, and the timer row of DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 belongs to rwb-case. (4) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the baseline can publish no enumeration beyond the decision set API Specification v4 gives, and no review-date range or decision code set can be declared. (5) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, and the S7 row of the connection matrix names Temporal to P7 and P8 with REST and events to P1, so the two moves are declared as the child workflow's stage outcome and any REST case-move operation carries a placeholder. (6) TSD S7 T8 maps every REQ-S7 row to FEAT-WOF-01 while the FSD Requirements served table gives REQ-S7-003 as the committee decision of approve, reject or defer. (7) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares four consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 with request CommitteeDecision and response DecisionLogEntry, T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, T3.2 as an empty list table and T8 mapping all eight REQ-S7 rows to FEAT-WOF-01; API Specification v4 CommitteeDecision properties and its decision enumeration, DecisionLogEntry properties and required list; FSD S7 Requirements served row REQ-S7-003, A2.8.3.1 rows R-WO-17 and R-WO-18, A2.8.3.2 field catalog and A2.8.4.4 with no background event; legacy RWB-E6-020 Data table field timer (DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036) and decision_log_entry; context pack connection-matrix row S7; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6020-CON with empty H, C, I and X
area: Contract surface, interface names, element properties and requirement trace
proposed: Publish the baseline over the API Specification v4 elements and name TSD S7 T-A.2 as the source of the operation and the error codes; declare reviewDate as the one additive optional property with a placeholder; bind every error condition to one message id of section 14; declare the defer inside the one published operation and not as a second path; declare the case read, the two moves, the timer answer and the package row as consumed and faked; declare the review timer as a durable workflow timer and register nothing; trace to REQ-S7-003 on the FSD table until the TSD T8 map is corrected
